items.title: Mojo Programming Language is Now Open Source
items.why: The open-sourcing of Mojo is significant for AI/ML developers, offering a new, potentially high-performance language option for system programming in the AI stack.

items.title: AI Wrote 1M Lines of Code and Refined It
items.why: This anecdote illustrates the rapidly advancing capability of AI to autonomously develop and refine large software projects, impacting the future of programming.

items.title: Extensible Software with LLMs and Sandboxes: A New Opportunity
items.why: This hypothesis suggests a renewed opportunity for extensible software platforms, enabled by LLMs lowering extension authoring costs and modern sandboxes reducing deployment risk.

items.title: Secure Sandboxing for Untrusted Code with smolmachines/smolvm
items.why: This research explores using lightweight virtual machines for securely sandboxing untrusted Python and JavaScript code, a critical topic for platform and security engineers.

items.title: LLM Development Shift: Focus on Coding Harnesses as Moore's Law Ends
items.why: This suggests marginal gains from new LLMs are diminishing, prompting engineers to invest more in prompt engineering and tooling for practical AI development.
